user_story: As a user, I want to receive an error message when I enter an invalid email format during registration so that I know to correct it.

positive.title: Valid email format registration
steps: Enter a valid email format (e.g., user@example.com)
Fill in the other required registration fields
positive.expected_result: User is successfully registered and redirected to the welcome page.

negative.title: Invalid email format registration
steps: Enter an invalid email format (e.g., user@.com)
Fill in the other required registration fields
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the email format is invalid.

edge.title: Edge case for email format registration with no domain
steps: Enter an email without a domain (e.g., user@)
Fill in the other required registration fields
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the email format is invalid.
